scope: Frozen golden_v1 natural_phrasing, all 30 items, joined on item_id to the exact stored development run; no retrieval or scoring rerun.

interpretation.limitations: Development claude_cli run; natural items are model-drafted, not independently authored or human reviewed. F-110 warns seeded lexical overlap inflates that source. F-138 diagnoses a different run and population; its causes are not transferred here. No causal effect or answer correctness follows from these associations or PASS/PARTIAL.
interpretation.largest_addressable_bucket: Eight verifier-terminal cases merit investigation: all have prose claims, and their stored retention is below 60% because NLI scores fail the saved threshold; seven have a complete gold set in generator input. This identifies an observable gate-side review opportunity, not proof that the claims are correct or that changing NLI will improve outcomes.
interpretation.verifier_checks: All claims in these eight cases have valid citations and entity_ok true, no XBRL contradiction, and no figure object. On the actual stored gate branch, prose entailment is compared with the saved threshold. Claim scores and retention below reproduce the failure checks, not a new scoring run. Item 0027 claim 1 contains printed 12 and has numbers_grounded true, but figure=null, so the stored gate applies NLI to it; this is a schema-branch observation, not a claim that numeric grounding failed.
interpretation.generator_declines: Six insufficient_evidence cases all received nonempty generator input; none received a complete gold evidence set. Three (0005, 0012, 0020) had a complete gold set somewhere in the full stored pre-rerank list; 0010, 0011, 0015 did not. 0015 nevertheless produced four claims retained by the gate; the model's own abstention takes precedence. Missing exact gold is not proof that alternative evidence was absent.
interpretation.routing: All 30 applied tickers match the named companies, and their resolved fiscal years and quarters match the questions and gold filing context. No filter_zero_recall was recorded and no period was unresolved; no wrong applied ticker or period is identified. Missing form constraints are not wrong filters. F-124 year-to-date and leading-article period traps are not observed here; these 30 do not establish that those traps are solved generally. Intent is 27 lookup, 2 comparison and 1 unsupported; 0009 is an answerable sourcing question classified unsupported. Whether lookup versus comparison is optimal for multi-part prose is not established by the gold question_type.
interpretation.floor: Saved threshold 0.5, exact rerank scores are not stored and are never borrowed from another run. For each single-query nonfallback case with nonempty post list the top score is >=0.5; for each nonfallback floor-empty case with nonempty candidates the top score is <0.5. The 0009 unsupported path has no score. Fallback bypasses the floor, so no bound follows. Multi-query item-level fallback is any-query fallback; per-query scores and individual bounds cannot be inferred from the combined list alone. Stored lists are truncated/interleaved; gold absence is not proof of irrelevance.
interpretation.rank_convention: Each trace uses id suffix with prefix hw_natural_phrasing_. Gold ID strings are shown in full. pre_rank and input_rank are one-based in the stored combined pre-rerank and generator input lists, null means absent; alternative sets are separated by semicolons, while plus joins required members of one set. Complete-set sufficiency means any nonempty gold set is entirely present. The pre list can exceed top 10; it is not sufficiency@10. A found rank does not prove evidence correctness. Per-item floor score is null in every trace; floor threshold is 0.5 in every trace. A missing exact score is not zero.
interpretation.flags: All 30 have filter_zero_recall=false, unresolved_periods=[], and top_score=null. Except 0005 and 0008, all executed retrievals are single-query. score_bound is >=0.5 for nonfallback nonempty input, <0.5 for the four nonfallback floor_empty cases, and unknown for fallback or unsupported. All expected_abstain=false. Post counts are generator input counts; pre/kept claims are stored claims_pre/claims_post counts. Evidence ranks identify gold only, not all retrieved chunks; the full lists remain in the hashed source results.

fallback_comparison.note: Source arrays are [abstentions, denominator, rate]. The all-run denominator includes deliberately unanswerable and adversarial questions. Fallback is timing/hardware dependent and can coincide with different source, intent and question difficulty; comparison is descriptive, not causal.

gold_overlap_by_outcome.note: Complete means all chunks of at least one alternative set occur in the entire stored list, not necessarily within its first 10. Exact-ID gold overlap is not a test for other valid evidence.

rerank_score.note: The null score and threshold apply to every trace; score_bound is per trace and only claims what the stored path establishes.
